comingLast.roast: done on 26 - blue looks good on him, the committee agrees
still swinging on 16 - hope dies on the 18th, usually
one decent hole (4 points) and he slips the blue ball noose onto Francis
he needs 3 points and a small miracle - the bar has odds on both
on 18 - the two blue balls have begun their lap of honour early
one hot hole and the blue balls change address to Francis's locker
the escape hatch: 9 points in 4 holes - all downhill from here, hopefully not literally
the maths says 11 in 6 - the golf so far says get comfortable
